reviewer: Codex source, numbered overlay, all small-component crops and 6x head comparison
observations: Full drawing and 117-region numbered overlay and uniform fill inspected. All 55 original small components inspected in paired source/overlay crops. Six enclosed dot centers in the tree retained, although only one to four pixels. Thirty-three isolated acute tips excluded explicitly. The long upper lip and eye crescent each reconnected independently using 64 connectivity-only pixels along the brightest interior path, with foreign-pane adjacency forbidden. Every unrelated pane remains distinct. Four teeth, curled pupil, open mouth, forked tongue, lower mouth cavity and lower lip remain separately bounded. Head and long scaled neck form one continuous area; curved scale strokes are open. The surrounding neck strip is separate. Names describe visible shapes and positions; the creature is described neutrally as a long-necked creature rather than asserting a historical identification. Main dividing bars are continuous. Canonical ink and blank pixels remain unchanged; earlier geometry retained for saves.
